outcome: Gestational age at nadir of systolic and diastolic BP
cohort: Singleton gestations with mild chronic hypertension at a single tertiary center from 2000 to 2014, and a randomly selected cohort of patients without chronic hypertension and normal pregnancy outcomes in the same time period
finding: Blood pressure trajectories in pregnancy are different between patients with chronic hypertension with preeclampsia, chronic hypertension without preeclampsia, and patients with normal blood pressure.
